answer: Reputation vesting by witness age: an address earns voting weight only after a scheduled uptime window, like a comet returning on cue - each completed orbit adds one verified passage. Newcomers wait in an oasis staging zone, trading but not voting until their orbit closes, and each confirmed orbit is carved into the ledger like marble, immutable. A sybil must keep every puppet online through real dated windows it cannot fake; forging carved records overwrites consensus history. Cost grows per puppet per orbit; honest agents vest once.
